
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/yupi/p/19091630" title="发布于 2025-09-14 18:31">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">我做了个 AI 文档阅读神器，免费开源！</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2225420/202509/2225420-20250914182550500-1223757362.png" alt="我做了个 AI 文档阅读神器，免费开源！" class="desc_img">
        为了帮助大家免受文档的折磨，我用 AI 开发了个 AI 文档助手网站，可以帮你快速读懂各种复杂的文档、还帮你管理文档。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">大家好，我是程序员鱼皮。开学季到了，想必很多朋友要开始收集和阅读论文，像我自己学习新技术知识也会去阅读文档，我深知阅读文档的痛苦。明明每个词拆开都知道什么意思，连一起就看不懂。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757559057843-b9d37369-49bf-4eec-878a-c70ac945cbd9.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757559057843-b9d37369-49bf-4eec-878a-c70ac945cbd9.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">为了帮助大家免受文档的折磨，我用 AI 开发了个 AI 文档助手网站，可以帮你快速读懂各种复杂的文档、还帮你管理文档。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757561248387-205bf672-7a6c-452a-a283-698fb526601c.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757561248387-205bf672-7a6c-452a-a283-698fb526601c.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">网站完全免费，代码完全开源！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">开源仓库：<span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a href="https://github.com/liyupi/literature-assistant" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="md-plain">github.com/liyupi/literature-assistant</span></a></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757829143308-d5bfdac6-847a-4061-9194-4821bdf3d3dc.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757829143308-d5bfdac6-847a-4061-9194-4821bdf3d3dc.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">下面先教大家如何使用网站，再分享这个网站的制作过程，还有国内使用 Claude Code 的方法哦。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">⭐️ 推荐观看视频版，2 分钟学会：<span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1MnpVzdETW/" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="md-plain">bilibili.com/video/BV1MnpVzdETW</span></a></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">如何使用？</span></h2>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">先下载开源代码到自己电脑，然后直接运行我提供的快速启动脚本，打开网页就能看到效果了。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">💡 要确保你的电脑有 Node.js 和 Java 环境，可以参考 README.md 文档安装。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757567928358-ad506045-faaf-47b1-b742-190c83c94ad3.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757567928358-ad506045-faaf-47b1-b742-190c83c94ad3.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">当你要阅读文档时，点击 “单个导入” 按钮，上传文档文件，然后需要填写 Kimi AI 的 API Key。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757560732751-de713284-c039-41c1-b9f4-0af34e4c703c.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757560732751-de713284-c039-41c1-b9f4-0af34e4c703c.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">选择 Kimi 是因为他们刚刚发布了新版本的 K2 模型，在编程、推理和文档理解方面都很不错；</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">而且支持 256K 的上下文，几十万字的论文也能搞定。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757560219469-2eab0801-a9b3-49dd-b680-d1d27c1850cf.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757560219469-2eab0801-a9b3-49dd-b680-d1d27c1850cf.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">在侧重考察真实软件工程任务的 SWE-bench Verified 等基准测试中，新版 Kimi K2 模型的表现也很不错：</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757560161782-1c78bd3c-a3a5-42f9-b79b-a0b07d808e6b.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757560161782-1c78bd3c-a3a5-42f9-b79b-a0b07d808e6b.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">只需要登录 <span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a href="https://platform.moonshot.cn/" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="md-plain">Kimi 的开发控制台</span></a><span class="md-plain">，然后进入 API Key 管理来获取一个调用大模型的密钥。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757560312832-cfd4158d-8c31-4c22-8b42-573551334863.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757560312832-cfd4158d-8c31-4c22-8b42-573551334863.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">虽然新人有免费额度，但是不要泄露自己的密钥哦！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757560674974-180d8475-e83e-4b35-ba9b-2ded866aa730.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757560674974-180d8475-e83e-4b35-ba9b-2ded866aa730.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">填写好 API Key，就可以生成文档阅读指南啦，生成速度非常快。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757560771758-4c3df93e-889d-4c74-afa2-90e69347f286.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757560771758-4c3df93e-889d-4c74-afa2-90e69347f286.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">AI 生成的效果还是不错的，图文并茂，能帮你更快理解复杂的文档。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757560820325-87111dd8-cd82-49d0-9385-24ea9a33e885.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757560820325-87111dd8-cd82-49d0-9385-24ea9a33e885.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你还可以批量导入多个文档，同时调用 AI 生成阅读指南，提高效率。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757560886812-1706415c-cff5-4475-872f-ba66891563f7.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757560886812-1706415c-cff5-4475-872f-ba66891563f7.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">此外，你还可以把这个网站当做自己的智能文档收藏夹，可以分类检索已经导入的文档、下载原始文件、随时查看文档阅读指南。<span class="md-pair-s "><strong>不要再让自己收藏过的文档找不到啦~</strong></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757560925975-079ad961-7cc8-498b-99e2-84a4a534023f.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757560925975-079ad961-7cc8-498b-99e2-84a4a534023f.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">怎么实现？</span></h2>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">如果是以前，这种网站可能要做个好几天。但现在 AI 编程技术已经很成熟了，我选用 Claude Code AI 开发工具，轻轻松松一天搞定，而且一行代码都不用自己写。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">首先在终端输入一行命令来安装 Claude Code：</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-builtin">npm&nbsp;install&nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">-g&nbsp;@anthropic-ai/claude-code</span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">然后执行 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>claude</code><span class="md-plain"> 命令，就可以向它提问了~</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">结果，报错啦！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1756451588360-37620a0b-bc2f-4ad5-adf9-4efde87f17ed.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1756451588360-37620a0b-bc2f-4ad5-adf9-4efde87f17ed.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>可恶啊，这破玩意还不支持国内使用！</strong></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">不过没关系，我们可以更换为 Kimi。在终端内输入命令来配置一段环境变量（注意区分操作系统）：</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-comment"># Linux/macOS 启动高速版 kimi-k2-turbo-preview 模型<br><span><span class="cm-keyword">export&nbsp;<span class="cm-def">ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL<span class="cm-operator">=https://api.moonshot.cn/anthropic<br><span><span class="cm-keyword">export&nbsp;<span class="cm-def">ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN<span class="cm-operator">=&lt;你的 API 密钥&gt;<br><span><span class="cm-keyword">export&nbsp;<span class="cm-def">ANTHROPIC_MODEL<span class="cm-operator">=kimi-k2-turbo-preview<br><span><span class="cm-keyword">export&nbsp;<span class="cm-def">ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL<span class="cm-operator">=kimi-k2-turbo-preview<br><span><span>​<br><span><span class="cm-comment"># Windows Powershell 启动高速版 kimi-k2-turbo-preview 模型<br><span><span class="cm-def">$env:ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL<span class="cm-operator">=<span class="cm-string">"https://api.moonshot.cn/anthropic";<br><span><span class="cm-def">$env:ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN<span class="cm-operator">=&lt;你的 API 密钥&gt;<br><span><span class="cm-def">$env:ANTHROPIC_MODEL<span class="cm-operator">=<span class="cm-string">"kimi-k2-turbo-preview"<br><span><span class="cm-def">$env:ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL<span class="cm-operator">=<span class="cm-string">"kimi-k2-turbo-preview"</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">然后就可以愉快地使用 Claude Code 生成代码了~</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1756451713145-29e5ba15-76b2-4848-903a-f098b942e2f9.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1756451713145-29e5ba15-76b2-4848-903a-f098b942e2f9.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">对于包含完整前后端的网站，很难用一段提示词就让 AI 生成出满意的效果，因此我们需要像企业真实开发一样 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>分解工作步骤</strong><span class="md-plain">。先后端、再前端、最后前后端对接联调，而且最好一个一个地开发功能，出了问题及时调整。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">分享一些参考的提示词：</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757567728565-5724de3e-7863-457b-9866-368c1535bd2c.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1757567728565-5724de3e-7863-457b-9866-368c1535bd2c.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<div class="md-hr md-end-block"><hr></div>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">以上就是本期分享，希望这个工具对大家有帮助，也不要忘记给鱼皮三连支持，谢谢大家~</span></p>
